name: Land Cover - All Classes (2025)
description: Land Cover from NLCD (National Land Cover Database) classifications are based primarily on Landsat data along with ancillary data sources, such as topography, census and agricultural statistics, soil characteristics, wetlands, and other land cover maps. NLCD 2025, produced by Multi-Resolution Land Characteristics (MRLC) Consortium, is a 16-class land cover classification scheme that has been applied consistently across the Continental 48 States at a spatial resolution of 30 meters. For additional information, go to https://www.mrlc.gov/. See https://viewer.nationalmap.gov/help for assistance with The National Map viewer, services, or metadata.
